# Grid

Column patterns that reflow; auto fits as many columns of at least minItem as there is room for.

Status: Stable. Semantic versioning applies: nothing breaks without a deprecation first.

`auto` is the one tools reach for: as many columns of at least `minItem` as fit — never a breakpoint. `seamless` cuts all the cells from one panel, so neighbours share a single keyline instead of doubling it.

## Usage

### When to use

- Cards or tiles that reflow with no breakpoints, with cols set to auto and a minItem.
- Fixed patterns of halves, thirds, quarters or fifths.
- Cells cut from one panel that share keylines, with gap set to seamless.

### When not to

- Rows of records with the same fields. Use [Table](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-data-display-table--overview.md).
- Headline figures, which have their own group. Use [Stat](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-data-display-stat--overview.md).
- One column or one row of items with a single gap. Use [Stack](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-layout-stack--overview.md).

### Content

- Keep tiles in a grid parallel: the same fields, in the same order, with the same units.

## API

### `Grid` (component)

- `cols`: `halves`, `thirds`, `quarters`, `fifths`, `auto` (default `thirds`)
- `gap`: `tight`, `default`, `wide`, `seamless` (default `default`)

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cols` | `"halves" \| "thirds" \| "quarters" \| "fifths" \| "auto"` |  |  |
| `gap` | `"tight" \| "default" \| "wide" \| "seamless"` |  |  |
| `minItem` | `string` |  | For `cols="auto"`: the narrowest a cell may get, as a CSS length. |

### `gridVariants` (function)

The responsive column patterns that recur. `auto` is the one a tool reaches for most: as many columns of at least `minItem` as fit, which is what a grid of stat tiles or agent cards actually wants — it never needs a breakpoint.

Types: `GridProps`

## Accessibility

Nothing in it takes focus, so there is no keyboard table.

### Mola handles

- Renders a plain `<div>` and never reorders its children, so reading order is source order.
- Collapses to fewer columns on narrow screens, so a page does not scroll sideways.

### You handle

- Put children in the order they should be read.
- Pass `role="list"`, and `role="listitem"` on each cell, when the cells are a list of like things.

### Testing status

- Automated, jsdom: each of its 2 stories is rendered and checked with axe on every pull request.
- Automated, browser: every story is checked in Chromium with axe, colour contrast included, in both themes, and for overflow at 390px.
- Keyboard in unit tests: not applicable.
